name: Ziffrin, Inc. v. Martin, Commissioner of Revenue of Kentucky, et al.

parties: Ziffrin, Inc. v. Martin, Commissioner of Revenue of Kentucky, et al.

opinions.text: H. Clyde Reeves, Commissioner of Revenue of Kentucky, Member of Kentucky Tax Commission and Member of Kentucky State Alcoholic Beverage Control Board, substituted as a party ap-pellee in the place and stead of James W.
